column1: # Every visible command of Astro CLI 1.x (main at 7aa23cdc), help and
# completion left out: the trees that had it, and its path without "astro".
# The trees are the ones cmd/v1_flags.tsv names: 1.x's Astro tree for a
# non-hosted organization (astro) and a hosted one (astro-hosted), and its
# It also lists every alias 1.x gave a command, since otherwise only the name
# is checked and v2 could drop an alias unnoticed. For each visible command
# and each of its aliases there is a path that spells the command by that
# alias at its own position and every group above it by name (deployment ls,
# not de ls). So a command with two aliases has two such paths, and an alias a
# group gave itself (deployment, de, deployments) is a path of its own
# (de, deployments). An alias of a group is not repeated under each command
# below it: cobra resolves one word at a time, so the group's own path covers
# it. The paths were walked off 1.x's cobra trees, with APC built as for the
# newest platform so that no version gate hides a command.
# It records 1.x, so nothing in v2 changes it, with one exception: a 1.x
# alias v2 dropped stays listed, and what it reaches is a stub. Today that is
# 1.x's de on every delete (deployment de), which v2 gave up because de is
# also deployment's own alias; each reaches a stub that names the command it
